To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the smart product is an object that can communicate and interact with the environment and other objects.
smart products are characterized by cyberphysical systems and are able to sense and react to their environment.
the smart product is a new concept that is not yet defined.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following questions: What is a smart product?
how smart products will be developed and deployed in the context of the fourth industrial revolution.
smart product development and its implementation in the industry.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the smart products are the products that are able to communicate with the environment and the users, and are able to sense the environment, to adapt themselves to the changing environment, to react to the changes, to make decisions and to learn from the experience.
a "smart product" is a product with embedded ICT, which is able to sense its environment, communicate with other products and with the environment, and to act autonomously.

smart product can be described as a product that has been designed and engineered to be able to collect and process data, and to be able to communicate with other smart products and with the environment in which it is operating.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we developed a smart product based on Radio Frequency Identification technology (RFID).
smart product is a product which is equipped with a set of technologies that enable it to sense, act and communicate.
we have designed and developed a smart product prototype based on RFID technology that is capable of interacting with a smart factory environment.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a smart product is not just an ordinary product with a smart label or tag.
a smart product is not only a smart object, it is also a product that has a life cycle.
smart products are not a single product or a single technology, but a combination of technologies and processes.
